title: Typing in the Categories Search box keeps the current sort
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC31 alpha) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC31 Beta) exists.
  • Category {Category-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC31 tier 9) exists.
  • Category {Category-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC31 Tier 10) exists.
  • Search term {Term-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC31) matches these four categories and no other category.
  • You are on a page other than Categories and the Categories Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Name column header once, so the list is Z to A.
  3. Type {Term-A} in the Search box.
  4. Wait until the list stops changing.
  5. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  6. Read every row shown and the Name header arrow.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: only {Category-A}, {Category-B}, {Category-C} and {Category-D} are shown. The Default category is not shown, because its name does not contain {Term-A}.
  • Step 6: they are still in Z to A order: {Category-D}, {Category-C}, {Category-B}, {Category-A} (Tier 10, tier 9, Beta, alpha), and the Name header arrow still points down.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R18 (with S1-R19 for the Default row), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Key Decision 'A sort belongs to the user until they leave the page'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R18: “Typing a search term keeps the sort. The rows that match the term are shown in the order the current sort produces.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “so does typing a search term, which refetches the matching rows and presents them in that same order.”
  • S1-R19: “The Default category is always the first row in the list. It holds that position under the Name sort and under the QuickBooks Products and Services sort, in ascending and in descending order alike, and it holds it after a reload in place. When a search term is typed it is first whenever it is among the matching rows; a term that does not match its name leaves it out of the results, as today, and it is never forced into them. This is the behavior the Categories list has in production today and it does not change.”
